# viettelcloud_lb_listener (Data Source)

Get a Viettel Cloud Load Balancer Listener by ID or name under a Load Balancer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lookup Load Balancer Listener by ID
data "viettelcloud_lb_listener" "by_id" {
  load_balancer_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  id               = "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
}

# Lookup Load Balancer Listener by name
data "viettelcloud_lb_listener" "by_name" {
  load_balancer_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  name             = "http-listener"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `load_balancer_id` (String) Load Balancer ID (UUID) that owns the listener.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Listener ID (UUID). Exactly one Listener must match.
- `name` (String) Name of the listener to filter by.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_cidrs` (Set of String) List of allowed IPv4 CIDRs that can access this listener.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the listener was created (RFC3339).
- `default_tls_cert_id` (String) Default TLS certificate ID (UUID) for the listener.
- `description` (String) Description of the listener (note: backend API omits description on detail responses and it resolves to null).
- `enable_h2` (Boolean) Whether HTTP/2 is enabled.
- `listener_timeout` (Number) Frontend client inactivity timeout in milliseconds.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol of the listener.
- `protocol_port` (Number) Port on which the listener listens for traffic.
- `provisioning_status` (String) Current provisioning status of the listener.
- `server_connecting_timeout` (Number) Backend connection timeout in milliseconds.
- `server_group_id` (String) Default server group ID (UUID) for the listener.
- `server_timeout` (Number) Backend member inactivity timeout in milliseconds.
- `set_x_forwarded_for` (Boolean) Whether X-Forwarded-For header is inserted.
- `set_x_forwarded_port` (Boolean) Whether X-Forwarded-Port header is inserted.
- `set_x_forwarded_proto` (Boolean) Whether X-Forwarded-Proto header is inserted.
- `sni_tls_cert_ids` (Set of String) Set of SNI TLS certificate IDs (UUIDs).
- `status` (String) Current operating status of the listener.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the listener was last updated (RFC3339).
